comment: The captain's hat (Visual Identity V01). Wind is the authoritative WeatherModel sample at the boat. The hat is checked once per check_interval_s of game time (an absolute grid), only while it is worn on deck. 'effective' wind = max(sustained, gust - gust_allowance_kn). Each band adds strain per game minute; strain recovers below deck, with the hat off, or in light wind. The hat blows away when strain reaches the hat's own threshold (between threshold_min and threshold_max, fixed per hat from the game's seed). The first minute of risk only warns.
